apps.name: Tomomix: Virtual Pets
apps.subtitle: Virtual pets, old and new
apps.localizedDescription: An iOS emulator for Tamagotchi-family devices. Does not include any firmware/ROM — bring your own.

versions.localizedDescription: The app is now called Tomomix, with a new purple icon. Adds early support for Tama-Go and Tamagotchi Friends (sound, pause and fast-forward for these two are still to come), plus export/import of their saves from the ⋯ menu. Everything is unlocked in this build.

Meet Tomomix, an original virtual pet built into the app: free, no ROM needed. Catch a shooting star, name your baby and raise it through 19 characters, with care icons, a memory game, a room and a meadow under the real sky, notifications, a retro screen option, and free screenshots and video. Also: per-model icons for first-generation Tamas, lit care buttons for the Yasashii and a new app icon. Everything is unlocked in this build.

Connect Nearby (Plus Color, iD, iD L, P's), Downloads (DLC) for the color Tamas, more first-generation models, a custom Screen Style for the original Tamagotchi, automatic backups, reworked sound with Respect Silent Mode and Mix/Pause for other audio, much faster play on older devices, and fixed A/B/C buttons on iOS 26. Everything is unlocked in this build.

Live translation (reads the LCD's Japanese UI text and shows an English translation, on-device or via your own Gemini/OpenAI/Anthropic API key), plus reduced GPU/CPU work around the live screen for noticeably less heat during normal play.

Opt-in reminder notification, an Appearance setting replacing the separate color pickers, Mute toggle removed in favor of the volume slider, button tray polish, and a bolder ambient-mode device label.
Multi-Tama swipeable gallery with drag-to-reorder, full-bleed ambient background during play, widget picker fix, perceptual volume curve, and a Plus Color animation/tempo tuning pass.
